t: The Hager Sollysta WMPB1/20 1-gang surface pattress is a durable white plastic single back box engineered for surface-mounted electrical wiring accessories. Featuring a 20mm internal depth, fixed lugs for straightforward installation, and 20mm knockouts positioned on the top, bottom, sides, and rear for versatile cable entry. Its clean white finish perfectly complements other Hager Sollysta moulded wiring accessories.
b: Matches all Sollysta White Moulded Wiring Accessories
